definitions.explanation: a deep, often solemn or profound feeling of joy and happiness

examples.japanese: {喜悦|きえつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧。
⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{喜悦|きえつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}した→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
examples.english: I shed tears of joy at the news of passing the exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|みの}り→実る：00282_minoru⟧、⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧{喜悦|きえつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: My years of effort bore fruit, and I felt an indescribable joy.

notes:
A literary and formal word for deep joy. Composed of {喜|き} (joy) and {悦|えつ} (pleasure/delight). More elevated in register than ⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧, and typically used in written language, speeches, or formal contexts. Conveys a sense of profound, heartfelt happiness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {喜悦|きえつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちる→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧: to be filled with joy
- {喜悦|きえつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧: tears of joy
- {喜悦|きえつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel elation
- {喜悦|きえつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|ひた}る→浸る：13339_hitaru⟧: to bask in delight

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧: joy — the standard, everyday word for happiness
- ⟦{歓喜|かんき}→歓喜：13172_kanki⟧: ecstasy, jubilation — even more intense, often used for collective celebration
- {悦|よろこ}び: delight — literary, emphasizes personal pleasure or satisfaction
- {愉悦|ゆえつ}: delight, pleasure — literary, with a nuance of savoring the pleasure
